description:
Not every girl gets what she wants on her 16th birthday, but Kobeni's gift is something she never saw coming: an arranged marriage! Thanks to her late grandfather, Kobeni's been engaged to a total stranger since childhood, and even though she's supposedly met him she doesn't remember a single thing about him. Even weirder is that both her Mom and creepily over-doting sister, Benio, seem completely unsurprised when the groom-to-be, Hakuya, and his younger sister, Mashiro, show up on the family's doorstep to move in with them!

But it's not until they start attending Kobeni's school that things take an even stranger turn after she starts to pick up some very... unusual vibes from her potential future family. From Mashiro's obsession with aliens and UMAs (Unidentified Mysterious Animals) to Hakuya's disconcerting lack of emotion, there's something very off about them that Kobeni can't quite put her finger on. What has her grandfather gotten her into, and how does this relate to the strange gap in Kobeni's memory?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

node.description: Hakuya's younger sister, who somehow manages to enroll in Kobeni's class. She often tries to vocalize that she isn't a child, but her honest feelings over her likes and dislikes are often read easily by the others. She is quite fearful of Benio but is easily swayed by sweet things.

Hakuya is Kobeni Yonomori's fiancé who suddenly appears on her 16th birthday with his little sister Mashiro Mitsumine. He and his sister start living in the same house as Kobeni and her own sister, Benio Yonomori.

__Race:__ ~!Half-Human/Half-Inugami!~

The main heroine, a responsible sixteen-year-old who handles cooking and chores well. 

On her 16th birthday, a young man named [Hakuya](https://anilist.co/character/87583) and [Mashiro](https://anilist.co/character/87582) suddenly appear in front of her, in which it turns out that Hakuya is her fiancé and Mashiro is her future sister-in-law.

~!When she was younger, she fell down a cliff but she was saved by Hakuya Mitsumine. The incident left her with a scar and little memory of the event, as she does not remember Hakuya when they meet again. Over time she recalls more of her memories of the incident, later learning she had received half of Hakuya's inhuman power, the side effect of which gives her a fever on occasion!~

Benio Yonomori is Kobeni's elder sister who has two personas: an immature and a carefree loving sister at home and the student council president at school, where she maintains her respectable popular image as a demure, well-mannered and an elegant top-performing student in front of her legion of fans. She has taken a liking to Mashiro to the extent that she would do all sorts of advances to her at home.

She is the student council secretary. She idolizes Benio due to how nice Benio was towards her when she first moved into town. As a result, she studied hard to get into the same school, and managed to work her way into the student council to be near Benio.

She hates Mashiro due to how close the latter seems with Benio, and even after Mashiro gets into a rant about how much she hates being smothered by her, Konoha refuses to see Benio in a bad light.
She is a member of the school's newspaper club, she is very nosy and often spies on ones personal affairs just to make a story.

The student council vice president. She is much more refined and mature than Benio (who is the student council president). She is always the one who keeps Benio in-check whenever she is getting out of control. Benio often calls her up whenever she is feeling down, even if the cause isn't that bad. This is much to Kashima's annoyance—so much so that she often hangs up.
